messages:
maria (sec-eng): Heads-up: There's a request from product for ad-hoc SIEM exports to external analysts. They want CSVs with 90 days of auth logs. I'm worried about broad RBAC + KMS handling. Thoughts?

alex (eng-sre): Noted. We should avoid giving long-lived bucket credentials. Prefer short-lived export tokens + scoped role. :thumbsup:

kevin (eng-platform): Agreed. Proposal: scoped \"export_viewer\" role with conditions (tenant, indexes, ttl). Generate signed URL that embeds a one-time export job id. Example token flow:
```
# request signed URL
POST /v1/exports
Body: {"scope":"tenant:acme","indexes":["auth","proxy"],"ttl":900}
Returns: { "url":"https://exports.redwood.ai/signed/abc123", "job_id":"e-1234" }
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://exports.redwood.ai/signed/abc123\" -o export.ndjson
```

maria (sec-eng): TTL 900s seems tight for analysts. Maybe 24h for download but limit the payload to redacted records and audit the job creation.

olivia (infra): We can do 24h URL but require explicit justification field and an approved ticket id. Also always write export to a customer-scoped S3 bucket encrypted with customer KMS alias like \"alias/tenant-acme-exports\". KMS logs then show usage.

kevin (eng-platform): On KMS: use envelope encryption with a per-tenant DEK encrypted by CMK. Rotate CMKs yearly. Also record kms:Decrypt events in our audit stream and forward to SIEM.

sam (legal): Make sure data minimization for partners: scrub sensitive fields (PII) and store hashed IDs only. Keep retention of export copies to 7 days.

maria (sec-eng): RBAC change ask: How do we ensure engineers can't create exports scoped to other tenants? We need service account RBAC rules + requestor bind.

alex (eng-sre): Implementation idea: ephemeral service account minted by authz service that is constrained to {tenant_id, allowed_indexes, exp}. Token creation requires 2FA for high-sensitivity tenants.

maria (sec-eng): Nice. Can we add a delegation audit entry that includes approver, justification, and ticket link? That needs to be exported to the audit index.

olivia (infra): Yes. We'll include an \"export_audit\" doc at creation time with fields: job_id, requested_by, approver, justification, scope, kms_key_alias, s3_path, status. It will be immutable.

kevin (eng-platform): Also implement a \"dry-run\" mode for analysts where export shows counts and sample rows until approval.

sre-bot: Deploy job triggered: export-service v2 -> canary; deployment window 22:00 UTC.

maria (sec-eng): Followups: 1) add automated masking rules for email/ssn 2) require approver from security for exports containing auth failures 3) document playbook for revoking URLs and wiping temporary storage.

alex (eng-sre): I'll open a PR for the RBAC policy + token issuer. Ping @maria when ready.

maria (sec-eng): Thanks — this covers the immediate ask. Will add legal to the ticket for retention language.
